time_semantics.first_engine_token_s: clock begins earlier than history.time, so start+first is an upper approximation, not an exact first-token timestamp
time_semantics.console_elapsed: rounded whole seconds since same request start
time_semantics.console_rate: cumulative mean since first token, not an instantaneous rate

limitations: No per-token wall-clock history exists in these snapshots.
Console request assignment is reconstructed from unique done matches, elapsed rounding, first-token upper approximations and line order.
Console bounds are conditional on stable clocks and approximately ordered, undelayed stdout prints; they are not certified measurement bounds.
Whole-request and batch averages are never allocated to individual seconds.
Short sub-second peaks of 300–400 tok/s are not excluded.

long_batch.wall_timestamp_limitation: No wall timestamps; matches place the same uninterrupted busy batch across target minute. 167.7 tok/s and 80.5% acceptance are averages of whole 918.139s block, not the target minute.
